note: Adapted from Emerson's (1928) redescription of the species established by Sjöstedt (1924), originally in English; the alate is described only from the queen, the male not being recorded; the worker is not described. The specimens are one queen, one soldier and several workers from the same nest in the Stanleyville region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (collected by Kohl, No. 26T); the soldier agrees exactly with the homotype, only somewhat larger. The synonymy citations, distribution and figure numbers have not been translated. Line-end hyphenation in the original has been joined.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: The original describes it from a single queen (Imago (Queen)). Head oval, brown; around the rather indistinct frontal gland opening a large pale area; head covered with setae and hairs; a median longitudinal dark line on the posterior part of the head. Antennal segment 3 equal to segment 4, segment 2 larger than segments 3 and 4. Compound eyes not large, rather close to the lower margin of the head. Ocelli medium-sized, width 0.267 mm, length 0.32 mm, 0.28 mm from the compound eye. Postclypeus rather short, paler than the head, with a median longitudinal line. Pronotum slightly paler than the head, the sides slightly rounded and strongly narrowing posteriorly; posterior margin slightly concave; corners rounded. Posterior margins of the meso- and metanotum more strongly concave. The sides of the queen's abdomen bear wart-like thickenings (recorded as a general character of the genus). Measurements (mm): head length 3.15, head width 2.71, compound eye diameter 0.67, pronotum length 1.22, pronotum width 2.45, hind tibia length 2.54, queen body length 71.00, queen abdominal width 11.00.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head red-yellow, rectangular; the sides almost straight and parallel. Antennal segment 3 shorter than segment 4, segment 4 equal to segment 2. Compound eyes represented by black dots behind the antennal bases. Mandibles proportionally short. Anterior and posterior margins of the pronotum both concave, the posterior concavity deeper than the anterior. Measurements (mm): head length 5.25, head width 2.40, pronotum length 0.79, pronotum width 1.66, hind tibia length 1.84, left mandible length 1.65.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier: T. anceps has shorter mandibles; T. badius has a proportionally greater head width and longer mandibles; T. patruus is smaller; T. mukimbunginis has a proportionally smaller head length; T. monodon has a shorter and wider head. Queen: T. apollo is larger; T. diana has the ocellus further from the compound eye than its own length; T. latialatus has the ocellus 0.13 mm from the compound eye in the homotype; T. buchholzi has the ocellus 0.11 mm from the compound eye.
